description.narrative: Founded in 2008, with 4,500+ workers in Africa, Sama (or the Company) is a B Corp Certified, AI data annotation company providing solutions that help prepare, train, and optimize AI algorithms so they can accurately recognize and differentiate data. IFC is considering an investment of up to US$10 million in Sama, and the project is expected to be supported by the IDA20 Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility. The funding will primarily be used to expand the Companys operations in Uganda.

The development impact of the project will be via: (i) Project Outcomes (Stakeholders): Direct employment opportunities for workers in Uganda, especially women and disadvantaged youth, resulting in improved livelihoods and skills upgrading. (ii) Contribution to Market Creation (Integration): Stronger integration of Uganda's digital entrepreneurship ecosystem, via capacity building channels.
